theme: Light mode primary (Institutional Luxe / Swiss Brutalist). High-contrast, paper-like feel. Backgrounds should be stark white or very light grey (slate-50) to make dense data pop without eye strain.

headings.family: Cormorant Garamond, Playfair Display, or Merriweather. (Premium, authoritative, editorial feel). DO NOT use Inter or generic sans for H1/H2.
headings.sizes: H1: text-3xl to text-4xl (Keep it restrained, not a marketing page), H2: text-2xl, H3: text-xl.

body.family: IBM Plex Sans, Manrope, or Inter (Clean, legible, modern UI sans).
body.sizes: text-sm to text-base. Use text-xs for dense tables.

data_numbers.family: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, or Roboto Mono (CRITICAL for financial data alignment).
data_numbers.features: tabular-nums slashed-zero (Ensure numbers align perfectly in columns).

base.background: #F8FAFC (slate-50) for canvas, #FFFFFF (white) for cards, data blocks, and active elements.

accents.brand: #0F172A (Deep Slate/Obsidian). Avoid bright 'SaaS Blue' for primary brand.

semantic_investigation_badges.ai_interpretation: bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border border-purple-200 (Distinct from facts, shows AI synthesis)

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (border-slate-200). Use the 'Grid Borders' strategy: expose the skeleton. Avoid soft drop shadows; rely on crisp borders for definition.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for floating menus/dropdowns, but main structural cards should be flat with 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: BANNED for this context. Use flat solid surfaces. Glassmorphism reduces data legibility in high-density professional apps.

components.underscope_investigation_card: Signature feature. Must explicitly separate intelligence layers. Include: 1. Semantic type badge (Fact/AI/Scenario). 2. 'Finding' (strong heading). 3. 'Why it matters' (muted text). 4. 'Evidence/Source' (monospace footprint). 5. 'Confidence Score' (progress bar or text label).
components.tables: Left-align text, Right-align numeric columns. Use tabular-nums strictly. Enforce a tight vertical rhythm.
components.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md) or crisp rectangular. High contrast. Primary: bg-slate-900 text-white. Secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200.
components.scenario_sliders: Use standard Shadcn UI slider but restyle the thumb to be sharp. Keep value labels clear and monospace.

grids_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids_layouts.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar navigation. Width 240px or 280px. Stark border-r, minimalist un-nested links.
grids_layouts.spacing: Strict 4px/8px rhythm. Padding in cards: p-4 or p-6.

motion.rules: Restrained, professional. No bouncy animations or excessive parallax.
motion.hover_states: Cards subtly shift border color to slate-400. Rows in tables get a subtle bg-slate-50 highlight. Fast transitions (duration-150 ease-in-out).

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA for all text. Never use text-slate-300 or text-slate-400 on white backgrounds.
accessibility.data_readability: Never use color alone to convey meaning. Always pair positive/negative colors with + / - signs or ↑ / ↓ arrows.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='investigation-card-expand', data-testid='watchlist-add').

media.charts: Use Recharts (Shadcn Chart). Clean lines, thin strokes. No fill gradients unless necessary for volume. Monospace labels on axes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Shadcn UI components as required (Card, Table, Slider, Tabs, Input, Button, Badge).
2. Avoid the standard 'Vercel SaaS' look. Make it feel like an authoritative institutional dossier (think traditional terminal meets modern web).
3. Use Lucide icons (already installed) for clean, minimalist navigation.
4. Implement browser LocalStorage for the Watchlist feature as requested by the user.
5. Seed realistic mock data. Avoid 'lorem ipsum'. Use financial terms ('supply chain dependency', 'margin compression', 'undisclosed related party transaction').
6. Build the contextual AI Research assistant to look like a dedicated panel/sidebar or distinct command interface, avoiding 'chat bubble' clichés.
7. DO NOT apply global `transition: all` in CSS. Only transition specific properties.
8. Strictly use tabular-nums (e.g. tracking-tighter tabular-nums) for all numerical financial data.
9. The Dependency Map can be a simple visual node representation or indented tree list for v1, provided it clearly outlines relationships.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth with borders and structured typography instead of muddy shadows.
Never center align the app container. Respect the natural left-to-right reading flow.
Add transitions for specific interactive elements (button, input), excluding transforms.
Do not use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) as icons. Rely on clean SVG icons (Lucide).
Ensure 2-3x more spacing for layouts where possible, though table rows can be dense.
Missing images will result in using placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Always use the provided media URLs.
